topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The flowers arrived in a silence that hung a bit too heavy in the air. No card to alleviate the mystery, no note to tie the bow on the bundle of questions they brought along. Each petal seemed to whisper, yet the room remained stubbornly mute. I touched the velvet edges, thinking of who might send such a message in colors and scents. A friend? An admirer? The bouquet sat there, a riddle in bloom, each stem a potential thread to unravel, but to where? I pondered the blooms, my fingers tracing the patterns, the room growing smaller with each passing moment.
